assets.name: Kurukshetra production GLB pack with CharMorph humanoid rigs
assets.source: mixed: CharMorph MB-Lab AGPL3-derived humanoid rigs plus MIRROR procedural Blender animal/vehicle shells
assets.author: MIRROR project; CharMorph/MB-Lab for humanoid base meshes and fitted cloth/hair
assets.license: AGPL-3.0-or-later; humanoid bodies and mounted riders are AGPL3-derived from CharMorph MB-Lab mb_male
assets.modifications: Six standalone humanoid files are generated with Product/scripts/generate-kurukshetra-charmorph-humanoid-glbs.py from CharMorph/MB-Lab mb_male, fitted with CharMorph lower-body cloth/hair meshes, then dressed with MIRROR-authored leather armor, close-fit face marks, crowns, and faction accents. Horse archer, war elephant, and war chariot files are generated with Product/scripts/generate-kurukshetra-charmorph-mounted-glbs.py: CharMorph/MB-Lab skinned riders/drivers are seated on MIRROR-authored procedural horse, elephant, chariot, wheel, and howdah shells. The 2026-06-17 pass assigns mount/vehicle materials during mounted export, bone-locks humanoid face/armor/clothing overlays, corrects mounted rider arm poses, darkens the runtime skin material toward the user's reference tone, lowers mounted rider placement, reshapes the elephant/chariot seating details away from obvious cube primitives, withholds loose weapon overlays plus ring/tack/rein/javelin accessories after user screenshots showed detached/floating bows, arrows, swords, shields, hoops, and wires, and mutes the faction cloth/paint palette so the live scene reads less like a bright tabletop marker set. Future approved replacements must preserve slot filenames and required clip names.
assets.attributionRequirement: Document CharMorph/MB-Lab AGPL3 derivation for all humanoid and mounted-rider GLBs and keep AGPL-compatible source/license notes.
assets.notes: All playable files with a human now include 159-joint skinned CharMorph real-human rigs; mounted files add rider_idle/rider_move/rider_attack/rider_hit overlays. Animal and vehicle shells remain procedural and remain the largest visible realism gap. Weapon, ring-shaped accessory, tack, rein, and spare-javelin meshes are intentionally withheld from the current export until proper constrained assets exist. The runtime plays embedded animation clips plus role-specific combat cues, but this is still not a final PUBG/GTA/Harry-Potter-chess realism pack.

assets.name: Procedural battlefield environment and effects
assets.author: MIRROR project
assets.notes: Board, terrain, fort/camp silhouettes, rocks, sparse trees, banners, off-board soldiers, ambient dust, non-gory impact rings/sparks/dust. The older off-board procedural horse/elephant/chariot entourage is not rendered in the live scene because close-camera review exposed toy-like and floating artifacts.
